scenarios.name: Cancel an active command while the panel selector is open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its solid block in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon displays the Modify panel
the user starts Shell from Modify
the Shell properties panel and model preview appear
the user opens the ribbon panel selector
the selector and Shell properties panel are both visible
the user clicks Cancel in the Shell properties panel
the selector and Shell properties panel close
the original solid block remains visible
the full 3D Model ribbon remains visible
